E0329

Direct braceless nesting in an arm table without a named subject (D-IFGUARD1=A)

What

Direct braceless nesting in an arm table without a named subject (D-IFGUARD1=A)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0329

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0329: tests/ui/subjectless_guard_direct_nesting.stderr.

Error [E0329]: a nested one-line `if` needs braces
  --> tests/ui/subjectless_guard_direct_nesting.jet:2:16
    |
  2 |     if true -> if false -> print("never")
    |                ^^
 Why: an adjacent body owns one non-`if` statement, so direct nesting is ambiguous
 Fix: wrap the nested `if` in `{ ... }`
